Limits: Controlled counterfactual structural patches, not rerun material drawing or automatic learning.
Old claims remain historically valid; statuses concern their application to the changed source.
Cell recurrence checks supplied topological boundaries, not nondegenerate Euclidean geometry.
Route revalidation checks the old ordered walk and headings, not continued maximality or uniqueness.
Fresh full-field discovery can remain globally incomplete while local old-candidate checks still support remote walks.
Held-out recurrence is deterministic conditional evidence; questions, cut and perturbation probe are authored. No independent statistical generalization or universal aesthetic law is claimed.
